dedupe_keys.name: the utilization status of urban green spcae in china

description: Huang and colleagues publish a shapefile describing urban green-space stock and actual utilization across 366 Chinese cities. The Science Data Bank page is PUBLIC, applies CC BY 4.0 and lists one 19.36 MB file. Its description names fields for total green-space area, used area and the ratio used, plus separate intra-urban and peri-urban values. An urban infrastructure modeller could use these attributes to compare available green space with areas that people appear to use when preparing public-space or heat-adaptation scenarios. The dataset is a city-scale summary, not a network of paths, park entrances or individual visits. The provider says land-use and points-of-interest data were combined to construct the indicators, but the inspected page does not state an observation year or explain all inference errors. The shapefile was not downloaded, so geometry, coordinate system and completeness of the 366 rows remain unchecked. Simulation at neighbourhood scale would need finer green-space geometry and local accessibility inputs. The provider title misspells “space”; its DOI is the stable identity. Related city population and heat layers would be needed to test access or cooling outcomes.
